results.title: Iran dismisses report of alleged 'dirty bomb' attack on Washington
results.content: Iran has said CNN's claim that Tehran would attack Washington with a "dirty bomb" was an attempt to manufacture further legitimacy to continue the war. Trump has said his administration takes the claim "very seriously."

results.title: APEC summit: What Trump, Xi and Putin want
results.content: Trump, Xi and Putin will hold their first trilateral meeting on the sidelines of APEC. With different priorities on trade, Ukraine, Iran and arms control, what does each leader hope to gain?

results.title: EU, ASEAN pursue deeper trade ties, but hurdles remain as businesses struggle with informal barriers
results.content: 2027 could be a landmark year for EU–Southeast Asia trade, with several deals nearing completion. But the harder task will be to ensure that businesses actually use them.

results.title: Guinea jails 200 in wildcat gold mining crackdown
results.content: A Conakry court has jailed 22 former local officials from the gold-rich northeastern Siguiri region, as well as 200 people accused of illegal mining. It's part of a wider crackdown that sent thousands fleeing into Mali.

results.title: Students' List candidates take seats as Serbian parliament opens
results.content: Serbia's Student List's candidates have taken their oaths in the inaugural parliament session. As the new majority, they have 90 days to form a government.

results.title: Nvidia scandal: China's chips dilemma, US rivalry shape AI race
results.content: The controversy over Nvidia's former CEO Jensen Huang and an alleged affair with a suspected spy has exposed the intensifying AI rivalry between the US and China.

results.title: Iran's growing exodus of young talent
results.content: Conflict and uncertainty are driving more and more educated young Iranians to consider leaving the country.

results.title: Guinea's gold rush: Arrests, deportations spark outcry
results.content: Guinea has banned illegal gold mining, citing environmental concerns. It has further charged hundreds of suspected local and foreign illegal miners amid reports of rights abuses and deportations.

results.title: Jordan bans Telegram app over 'radicalisation' claims
results.content: Jordan has imposed a ban on Telegram over a deadly church attack which left seven people dead. Iraq later followed with a partial ban to compel the company to review its content.

results.title: Mozambique's justice under scrutiny as Venancio Mondlane faces trial
results.content: The trial of opposition politician Venancio Mondlane begins in Mozambique on Tuesday. The former presidential candidate is facing five charges, including incitement to terrorism.

results.title: Goodbye, overtourism? Sustainable travel gains ground
results.content: As tourism booms across Latin America, alternative forms of travel are gaining ground. Making your holiday more sustainable means rethinking who calls the shots, who invests and who benefits.

results.title: Despite restrictive abortion laws, Poland's 'Abortomat' — a locker that dispenses abortion pills — helps women who want to end a pregnancy
results.content: Abortion laws in Poland are very restrictive. Activists there have found a new way to help women wanting to terminate a pregnancy: the "Abortomat," a locker that dispenses abortion pills. But they face fierce opposition.

results.title: ASEAN offers Myanmar's sidelined leaders a path back to summits, but says restrictions will stay until there is meaningful progress on its peace plan
results.content: Southeast Asian leaders have agreed to engage Myanmar in stages after years of excluding its leaders from high-level meetings. The bloc says Myanmar could regain full representation if it makes progress on a peace plan.
